title: Dedenle tavla

characters.GRANDPA: a grandfather in his seventies with white hair and a thick white mustache, wearing a beige knitted vest over a white shirt
characters.BOY: a boy of about eight with short dark brown hair, wearing a blue and white striped sweater
characters.MAN: a man of about thirty-five with short dark brown hair, wearing a blue sweater
characters.SON: a boy of about seven with short dark brown hair, wearing a green t-shirt

scenes.text:
Dedenle oynadığın her tavlayı
neden hep sen kazanırdın?
scenes.prompt: In a garden under an apple tree in autumn, {GRANDPA} on the left and {BOY} on the right sit at a small wooden table with a wooden backgammon board between them, golden leaves falling, late afternoon sun.

scenes.text:
Zarlar atılır,
o şaşkın şaşkın başını kaşırdı.
scenes.prompt: {GRANDPA} sits at the garden table with a playfully puzzled face, looking down at the wooden backgammon board, an apple tree with autumn leaves behind him, warm golden light.

scenes.text:
Sen sevinçten bağırırdın,
o gülümseyip taşları yeniden dizerdi.
scenes.prompt: At the garden table, {BOY} on the right throws both arms up in joy, while {GRANDPA} on the left smiles warmly at him, a backgammon board on the table, autumn leaves drifting down.

scenes.text:
Yıllar sonra oğlunla oynarken
bilerek yanlış bir hamle yaptın.
scenes.prompt: At the same wooden garden table under the apple tree at sunset, {MAN} on the left smiles knowingly while {SON} on the right leans over the backgammon board with an excited face, golden leaves falling.

scenes.text:
İşte o an anladın: deden hiç kaybetmemişti.
Bunu dedesini özleyen birine gönder.
scenes.prompt: {MAN} sits alone at the wooden garden table at sunset, smiling softly and looking up at the old apple tree, golden autumn leaves falling slowly around him, warm glowing sky.

caption:
Deden seni yendi mi?

Bazı yenilgiler sevginin en sessiz hâlidir. 🤍

Bunu dedesini özleyen birine gönder.
